item.title: Jharkhand High Court quashes electricity duty on “net charges” for breaching constitutional limits and excessive delegation
item.description: “If electricity duty is charged on per cent of ‘net charges’ for energy consumed or sold, then similarly situated persons pay different duty depending on the distribution licensee, since the tariff fixed by the JSERC varies, which would amount to violation of Article 14 of the Constitution.” The post Jharkhand High Court quashes electricity duty on “net charges” for breaching constitutional limits and excessive delegation appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court stays NHAI’s Termination Notice in Delhi-Mumbai Expressway Contract Dispute
item.description: The Court accepted the contention that encashment of insurance surety bonds aggregating to nearly ₹100 crores, prior to final adjudication, would result in grave and irreversible loss and injury. The post Delhi High Court stays NHAI’s Termination Notice in Delhi-Mumbai Expressway Contract Dispute appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Know Thy Judge | Supreme Court of India: Justice Sandeep Mehta’s stellar career and notable judgments
item.description: Justice Sandeep Mehta, formerly the Chief Justice of Gauhati High Court, took oath of office as Judge of Supreme Court of India on 9-11-2023 and will be retiring on 10-01-2028. The post Know Thy Judge | Supreme Court of India: Justice Sandeep Mehta’s stellar career and notable judgments appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Sidhanth Singh Journey as EBC SCC 8th Student Ambassador
item.description: Watch Sidhanth Singh from Campus Law Centre, Faculty of Law, University of Delhi as he shares his journey as a Student Ambassador at the 8th EBC-SCC Student Ambassador Conclave. The post Sidhanth Singh Journey as EBC SCC 8th Student Ambassador appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Quasi-judicial authority has no power to review unless statutorily granted’: Patna HC reinstates Panchayat Teachers after 10 years
item.description: “The power of review being substantive in nature cannot be applied retrospectively to validate actions taken at a point of time when no such power existed.” The post ‘Quasi-judicial authority has no power to review unless statutorily granted’: Patna HC reinstates Panchayat Teachers after 10 years appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Stranger cannot be drawn into proceedings under Section 498-A IPC: Karnataka High Court quashed proceedings against neighbor
item.description: “Permitting further proceedings against the neighbor would become an abuse of the process of the law and result in miscarriage of justice.” The post Stranger cannot be drawn into proceedings under Section 498-A IPC: Karnataka High Court quashed proceedings against neighbor appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Authorities can’t have control over any amount paid as deposit or pre-deposit during investigation: CESTAT
item.description: CESTAT further held that amount deposited by assessee during investigation could not be retained after demand of excise was set aside. The post Authorities can’t have control over any amount paid as deposit or pre-deposit during investigation: CESTAT appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises WorkIndia on its USD 10.8 million Series B Investment
item.description: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advised WorkIndia on its USD 10.8 million Series B investment round, supporting the growth of a technology-driven recruitment platform for India’s blue and grey-collar workforce. The post Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises WorkIndia on its USD 10.8 million Series B Investment appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “His right to earn livelihood cannot be curtailed”: Allahabad HC grants bail to father who repeatedly raped his minor daughter
item.description: “The conviction and sentence awarded to convict shall also remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal, since he is a Government servant and his right to earn his livelihood for survival cannot be curtailed because of implication in this case.” The post “His right to earn livelihood cannot be curtailed”: Allahabad HC grants bail to father who repeatedly raped his minor daughter appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised ARM Embedded Technologies Private Limited
item.description: The transaction involved a long-term lease of the Taurus-4 (North Tower) building, including extensive parking facilities, reinforcing ARM’s operational presence in India’s technology hub. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised ARM Embedded Technologies Private Limited appeared first on SCC Times.
